source.ref: Kaiser Aluminum, Rod & Bar Alloy 6061 Technical Data (KA-RBH-6061-8.10), typical values; accessed 2026-11-11. Modulus of Elasticity printed as 10.0 x 10^3 ksi (US column) and 68.3 GPa (metric column). The two disagree: 10.0 x 10^3 ksi x 6.894757 MPa/ksi = 68.95 GPa, 0.95% above the printed 68.3 GPa. Chosen 68.95 GPa, the exact conversion of the primary US value; range 68.3 to 68.95 GPa.

source.ref: Blau, 'Appendix: Static and Kinetic Friction Coefficients for Selected Materials', ASM Handbook Vol. 18, ASM Intl 1992, ISBN 0-87170-380-7 (dry, room temp.). Rule (all metals): steel 1032 fixed, test material moving, kinetic; Magnaplate 1988 rig, 1.96 N, 54% RH. Steel 1032 / Al 6061-T6: static 0.47, kinetic 0.38. Reverse (Al fixed / steel moving): 0.35, 0.25. Engineering ToolBox Al on mild steel kinetic 0.47. Range 0.25 to 0.47.
